cards.title: Redefining Home
cards.text: Finding insights into how people create and carry home.

feedback: “It’s been gorgeous...I didn’t expect the conversation to be so emotional. I know that I have a solid sense of home...It’s been really amazing to unpack what that foundation means for me, I hadn’t really thought about it this deeply before so thank you.”

“I love the questions you asked me. It was really helpful, really nice... I just really think that it's nice that we appreciate home as a feeling. Because that also means that you can technically be home everywhere you are.”
